checks.name: ruff
checks.command: ruff check and ruff format --check for changed Python files

scheduling_controls: ASR run_once holds a cross-process file lock before claiming work and keeps it through inference.
ASR worker estimates a request from full local artifact bytes (2x weights plus 512 MiB runtime overhead) and defers model construction when it does not fit.
All local_inference_slot users use measured OS available memory minus a 2 GiB reserve, capped by MED_TRANSCRIPT_LOCAL_MEMORY_BYTES.
Worker transcript provenance records the exact memory request, availability observation, reserve and admission decision.
The ASR backend pool serializes in-process model loads and closes the previous backend before switching.
limitations: The 2x artifact-size estimate is a conservative heuristic, not a measured per-model peak requirement.
The 2 GiB OS reserve is fixed and should be tuned from deployment measurements.
The worker-level TestClient case that also checks API state hung in this Windows environment; socket-free admission tests and worker source inspection passed.
The scheduler serializes only application processes using the configured lock path and does not control unrelated OS processes.
